description: Generate a Terms of Service agreement for an app or service using privacypage.io. Returns a free 25-line preview and a documentId; the full document is unlocked with a one-time license ($9.99, no subscription).

jurisdiction.description: Governing law jurisdiction, e.g. 'California, USA' or 'London, UK'

keyPolicies.description: Key policies that apply. Common values: 'Refunds allowed', 'No refunds', 'User-generated content', 'Account termination rights', 'Subscription auto-renewal', 'Free trial terms', 'Intellectual property protection'.

serviceName.description: Name of the app or service, e.g. 'MyApp'

name: generate_terms_of_service
title: Generate Terms of Service
